en.title: UN warns global warming to surpass 1.5°C limit
en.hook: Even engineers should pay attention – UN warns global warming is set to exceed the 1.5°C threshold
key_takeaways: UN report predicts global warming will surpass the 1.5°C limit
The warning signals urgent need for climate action
Scientific findings underscore the importance for policymakers and tech innovators

zh.title: 联合国警告全球变暖将突破1.5度限制
zh.hook: 直击工程师痛点的1句话亮点：联合国警告全球变暖将突破1.5度限制，警示气候危机迫在眉睫
key_takeaways: 联合国报告显示全球变暖已接近或将突破1.5度阈值
这一警告凸显了采取紧急气候行动的必要性
